title: Dyslipidemia guideline
summary: PREVENT-ASCVD risk assessment and LDL-C treatment goals are part of the updated guideline.

changes.label: Risk assessment
changes.before: Pooled Cohort Equations in the 2018 framework.
changes.after: PREVENT-ASCVD in eligible adults aged 30–79; updated risk categories.

changes.label: Treatment goals
changes.before: The prior framework emphasized statin intensity and percentage LDL-C reduction.
changes.after: LDL-C and non-HDL-C goals accompany percentage reduction and risk-based treatment.

title: VA/DoD hypertension
summary: The 2026 guideline replaces the 2020 version; systolic and diastolic targets remain separately graded.

changes.label: Systolic goal
changes.before: The 2020 <130 mmHg recommendation was graded Weak for.
changes.after: The 2026 <130 mmHg recommendation is Strong for, with individualized characteristics and preferences.

changes.label: Diastolic goal
changes.before: The prior guideline recommended <90 mmHg for adults aged ≥30.
changes.after: The <90 mmHg pathway is Weak for; evidence is insufficient for <80 versus <90 mmHg.

title: VA/DoD lipid management
summary: The updated provider summary suggests PREVENT risk assessment and removes prior recommendations about routine lipid testing frequency.

changes.label: Risk assessment
changes.after: PREVENT is suggested, graded Weak for.

changes.label: Lipid monitoring
changes.before: Recommendations addressed testing frequency and routine monitoring.
changes.after: Those 2020 recommendations were removed; review the new guidance before changing practice.
